latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: laomo-weather 2.1.0 introduces a fully bilingual, feature-rich, and free weather skill.

- Added support for AQI, pollen data, extreme weather alerts, and lifestyle suggestions.
- Full Chinese/English output with automatic translation of all weather and air quality terms.
- Multi-city comparison and smart city/coordinate recognition.
- Uses only free APIs (no keys required), with fallback across wttr.in and Open-Meteo.
- New modular architecture and extensive documentation included.
- Old metadata removed and updated to new format.
